title: Berlin B-Plan (Bebauungsplan) WFS — plan LOCATOR adapter
authority: Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen Berlin (GDI-BE / FIS-Broker)
PROBE_VERDICT: ⚠ CORRECTED by live probe 2026-07-31 — see ../PROBE-VERDICT-2026-07-31.md. The dual-endpoint DISCREPANCY is RESOLVED: the production extraction endpoint is the LEGACY `bplan` WFS (NOT `plu_bplan`). The document-link field is `grund_www` (NOT `inhalt`). Live GetCapabilities/GetFeature confirmed.
CRITICAL_locatorNotRuleTable: ⚠ This WFS is a plan LOCATOR, NOT a rule table. GRZ / GFZ / Vollgeschosse / height / Baugrenze are NOT present as attributes in the B-Plan WFS schema. They live ONLY in the linked Begründung/Satzung PDF (the legal plan document). Therefore farRatio, maxHeight_m, maxFloors, maxCoverage and setbacks MUST stay `unknown` and are NEVER populated from GIS/WFS metadata — only from extracted, human-verified, cited plan text attached to the exact planid. See EXTRACTION-PIPELINE.md for the extraction bridge.

productionEndpoint.confidenceBasis: Live GetCapabilities + GetFeature 2026-07-31 (see ../PROBE-VERDICT-2026-07-31.md). CRS EPSG:25833, licence DL-DE/Zero-2.0, no access restriction. GetFeature CQL_FILTER planname LIKE '8-30%' returns Neukölln 8-30 with grund_www + scan_www populated.

featureTypes.name: bplan:b_bp_fs
featureTypes.describes: festgesetzt (in-force plans) — CARRIES document fields — the extraction target

featureTypes.name: bplan:c_bp_ak
featureTypes.describes: außer Kraft gesetzt (repealed) — carries document fields

featureTypes.name: bplan:a_bp_iv
featureTypes.describes: in Verfahren (in procedure / drafts) — NO document fields (expected: not adopted)

productionEndpoint.extractionQueryRule: Query bplan:b_bp_fs (festgesetzt) / bplan:c_bp_ak (außer Kraft) for the document links.

documentFields.grund_www: Link zum Begründungstext — THE EXTRACTOR'S TARGET (GRZ/GFZ/height/storeys stated here in prose + Festsetzungen).
documentFields.scan_www: Link zur Planzeichnung — the drawing PDF (not the reasoning text).

inspireEndpoint.role: INSPIRE interchange only (NOT the extraction endpoint)
inspireEndpoint.confidence: LIVE-PROBED (responds, but document link is indirect)
inspireEndpoint.confidenceBasis: Live probe 2026-07-31: plu_bplan responds, but its document link is INSPIRE-modeled and INDIRECT (via OfficialDocumentation object, not a direct PDF). Use for INSPIRE-conformant interchange, NOT for pulling the Begründung PDF.
inspireEndpoint.documentLinkageNote: The former assumption `documentLinkageField: inhalt` was the plu_bplan/INSPIRE model — it is NOT the production path. Corrected to bplan/grund_www. See ../PROBE-VERDICT-2026-07-31.md §2.

DISCREPANCY_RESOLVED: The former DISCREPANCY (plu_bplan/inhalt VERIFIED-SCHEMA vs bplan/scan_www CONVERGENT-SECONDARY, no winner asserted) is RESOLVED by live probe 2026-07-31: `bplan` is the production extraction endpoint, document link is `grund_www`. `plu_bplan` also responds but its link is INSPIRE-indirect.

fields.grund_www: Link zum Begründungstext — the legal-document (reasoning-text) linkage — EXTRACTION TARGET
fields.scan_www: Link zur Planzeichnung — the drawing PDF

directPDF.note: grund_www resolves directly to the Begründung PDF (e.g. …/begruendung/begruendung-8-30.pdf). scan_www resolves to the Planzeichnung PDF. Confirmed live 2026-07-31.

extractedRuleFields.note: These are the buildability fields the product needs. NONE are served by this WFS. All resolve ONLY via the Begründung-text extractor (EXTRACTION-PIPELINE.md) + L-449 human verification. For 8-30 the probe SAW GRZ 0,3 / GFZ 0,9 in the grund_www PDF — but formal extraction+sign-off is still pending; values below stay unknown until an L-449 row exists.
